description: This script automates the creation and deletion of a Kubernetes kind cluster, including provider detection, argument parsing, and readiness checks.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Outputs informational messages in blue color.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Outputs success messages in green color.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Outputs warning messages in yellow color.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Outputs error messages in red color and exits.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays help and usage information for the script.

methods.name: provider_installed
methods.description: Checks if a container provider (docker or podman) is installed.

methods.name: provider_responsive
methods.description: Checks if the container provider responds (is running).

methods.name: detect_provider
methods.description: Automatically detects whether docker or podman is installed and responsive.
